newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Telefonica, Santander, BCH take A-3 TV stake.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Telefonica, Santander, BCH take A-3 TV stake.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica told the national stock market commission on Monday that it would buy 25 percent of Antena 3 de Television for 25.98 billion pesetas in a deal that included 49 percent of soccer viewing rights firm GMA for 18.53 billion pesetas.
Spanish banks BCH and Santander also form part of Telefonica's deal, taking 7.14 percent and 11.58 percent of Antena 3 respectively, and one percent each of GMA.

BCH told the stock market commission it would make a total investment of some 7.0 billion pesetas through its subsidiary Macame SA for one percent of Gestora de Medios Audiovisuales Futbol-GMA and to increase its stake in Antena 3 by 7.14 percent to 21.4 percent.
Santander said it had agreed to buy up to 11.57 percent of Antena 3 for 10.7 billion pesetas and one percent of GMA for 378 million pesetas.
Telefonica de Espana announced on Friday that it had agreed to buy 25 percent of Antena 3 at a price that had yet to be determined. It will make the purchase through its unit Telefonica Multimedia.
GMA owns 40 percent of Audiovisual Sport, a unit of Antena 3, which together with Televio de Catalunya and Sogecable, controls the rights to Spain's lucrative soccer broadcasts.
